post.summary: Search scoped knowledge with keyword/vector ranking
post.description: Minimum role: viewer. V3 instance and environment scope apply. Keyword and vector candidates use the same current explicit environment, active application mapping and V3 environment/knowledge grants. A document carrying team_id must match the application current owner team and have an additional team knowledge grant. Candidate document ID/version and current grants are rechecked before output; malformed or unknown scope and legacy source_registration_id documents are excluded pending trusted provenance. A separately stored, credential-free, single-page public HTTPS Markdown body can supply bounded keyword passages only when its latest read observation, content hash, revision, application/environment/team binding and current grants all match at candidate and final output checks. One 30-second budget covers the whole search, and more than 80 SQL-matched public Web sources across all visible application/environment scopes returns 413 public_web_source_scope_too_large. No public Web vector indexing, Agent tool, source page DTO or full source index is proven. When embeddings are unavailable, returns a keyword result with degraded=true; an unavailable keyword index returns 503. Synced upload sources are keyword-searchable from their latest read under the same scope and grants as their evidence proof; they have no vector index (PA-66). Feishu and other bound external readers and Git Markdown sources are not searched yet. corpora lists, per corpus, whether keyword and vector search ran (searched), failed (unavailable), have no index (not_indexed) or are not read by this search (not_searched).

Current application, environment and owner-team grants are checked. status_source distinguishes the authoritative legacy status from any missing derived evidence. proposal_id is null because no V3 proposal link exists. Chart arrays, thresholds, report severity and action items have no producer and are null with missing reasons. A succeeded status is the legacy executor result and is not by itself proof that a report exists or is published. The frozen frontend Execution DTO expects populated mock fields and requires a null-aware adapter. A V3 rollback execution (kind kubernetes.deployment.rollback) is projected from the rollout ledger with its timeline, rollout readback and verification samples (PA-08).

post.summary: Change own local password and revoke all own sessions
post.description: Minimum role: viewer. Requires current password and a different new password. New passwords contain 8–128 Unicode characters and require ASCII uppercase and lowercase letters, ASCII digits, and at least one Unicode punctuation or symbol character; invalid values return 422 invalid_password. Existing password input retains the 1024-byte login cap, without applying new password complexity rules. Directory source is metadata, not SSO: any active identity with a valid local password hash may change it. No configured local password returns 422 no_local_password. Wrong current password returns 422 incorrect_password, preserving the session. Successful hash update, all-user-session revocation and secret-free audit are transactional; response expires the current cookie. A new login is required.

Evidence that would exceed the model input budget after tool calls is trimmed, oldest first, in the model request only (each trimmed result says so) instead of failing the turn (PA-45). A reply cut at the model output limit is completed, not failed: it keeps the streamed answer, adds a status part in the request language and carries finish_reason=max_output_tokens on message.completed and the message (PA-46). When the reply uses its evidence-tool budget (32 reads), the next model call has no tools and answers from the evidence gathered; the reply completes with finish_reason=evidence_limit and a status part. An identical repeat of a tool call (same tool and input) is answered from the earlier result without a read or a count, and over-budget calls get an evidence_limit tool error instead of canceling the reply (PA-52).
